# Meshy free-library shortlist (2026-09-29)
Source: https://www.meshy.ai/free-3d-models (community models). Meshy terms 3.3: published community 3D models are **CC0**.
**Check each model's own `license` field before use** (only 27 were verified before Meshy rate-limited the scan; see note below).
Model page: `https://www.meshy.ai/3d-models/x-<id>`. Picked by eye from thumbnails for the `ashes-art-style` look.
Skipped: other people's IP (Dragon Ball, Hollow Knight, Chocobo, Santa, Fortnite-titled), national flags, grey/untextured, cute/off-style.
Triangle counts vary from 4k to 2.3M, so everything needs decimating and baking for mobile (target 5-20k tris).

**Rate limit:** fetching pages quickly (6 in parallel) got a 403 block from Meshy. When resuming, go one page at a time, 3 s or more apart.
